mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_logs ( member_id, endpoint, http_method, status_code, response_time_ms, ip_address, user_agent, request_body ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{endpoint}, #{httpMethod}, #{statusCode}, #{responseTimeMs}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{requestBody} );
mapper.select: select id as a_id, member_id as a_member_id, endpoint as a_endpoint, http_method as a_http_method, status_code as a_status_code, response_time_ms as a_response_time_ms, ip_address as a_ip_address, user_agent as a_user_agent, request_body as a_request_body from api_logs;

select id as a_id, member_id as a_member_id, endpoint as a_endpoint, http_method as a_http_method, status_code as a_status_code, response_time_ms as a_response_time_ms, ip_address as a_ip_address, user_agent as a_user_agent, request_body as a_request_body from api_logs where member_id = #{memberId};
